scenes.title: Recognition by Signs
scenes.summary: The least artistic kind: birthmarks, scars, necklaces, the little boat in the Tyro; Odysseus' scar is used better with the nurse than with the swineherds.

scenes.title: Contrived Recognitions
scenes.summary: Recognitions contrived by the poet: Orestes announcing himself in the Iphigenia, the voice of the shuttle in the Tereus.

scenes.title: Memory
scenes.summary: Recognition through memory: the Cyprians of Dicaeogenes, and the tale told to Alcinous, where Odysseus weeps at the singer's song.

scenes.title: Reasoning
scenes.summary: Recognition by reasoning: the Libation Bearers, Polyidus on Iphigenia, Theodectes' Tydeus, the Phinidae.

scenes.title: False Inference
scenes.summary: A composite recognition made from the audience's false inference: Odysseus the False Messenger.

scenes.title: The Best Recognition
scenes.summary: The best arises from the incidents themselves, through probable events, as in Sophocles' Oedipus and in the Iphigenia.
